text:
alyssa_cs: Morning — quick sync on Lighthouse private/VPC onboarding. Customer's go-live is next Tue, and they still need audit log forwarding + KMS policy finalized. Also asked about longer retention for access logs.

mike_infra: Hi — I tried the proposed Transit GW peering last night, looks fine from our side. Waiting on their networking to confirm route tables. @alyssa_cs do you have their CIDR ranges?

alyssa_cs: Yes, sending now: `10.240.0.0/16` and `192.168.100.0/24`. They said security team wants explicit deny for public egress for the inference subnets.

sam_sre: For audit logs: we can forward to their Splunk HEC or S3. Which one do they prefer? Also retention needs to be clarified — default is 90 days in Private console.

rina_security: They requested KMS key with rotation disabled and cross-account decrypt disabled. We recommended rotation enabled; need to capture risk for renewal. If they insist on rotation off, note as a compliance risk.

harper_eng: On the KMS policy: here's the minimal trust block we need from their side:
```
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-inference"},
  "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:Encrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
  "Resource": "*"
}
```
They need to add our role and enable key usage in their account.

alyssa_cs: Copy. I'm scheduling a 30min playbook run-through with their ops and security at 2pm PT today. I'll invite @mike_infra and @rina_security. Also capturing their feedback: they'd like an onboarding checklist PDF and an optional walkthrough for audit queries.

sam_sre: Can you add an item to ensure `aws:SourceVpc` constraints are set on the KMS key? Prevents cross-vpc misuse. Also we'll enable prefix/KV cache exception for inference metadata to avoid PII caching.

harper_eng: Noted. I'll update the deploy scripts and send a PR with the exact IAM docs link: https://redwood.ai/internal/priv-kms-iam

alyssa_cs: Thanks. Two blockers to unblock before go-live: 1) their net team confirms the route tables + NACLs, 2) KMS policy agreement and their decision on retention. If both clear, we can start smoke tests tomorrow morning.

ops-bot: Deploy check scheduled: private-onboard/lighthouse-smoke-tests at 2026-03-23T08:00:00Z :white_check_mark:

rina_security: One more: capture their audit log sample schema — they want field-level logging for request IDs. @alyssa_cs please add that to the enablement doc.

alyssa_cs: Will do. I'll follow up with meeting notes and next steps afterwards. Anyone else? :thumbsup:

mike_infra: :thumbsup: I'll be on the call.

harper_eng:+1

sam_sre: Going to draft the risk note for renewal — if they lock rotation off that's a potential condition. Will share within the hour.

alyssa_cs: Great, thanks team. I'll post notes and the checklist after the call.
